integrity_statement: The exact threshold uses the classical sharp two-eigenvalue exact-line-search contraction identity. The phase-resolved failure probability and its two asymptotics are assessed as a distinct method-specific result; literature priority uncertainty remains. All numerical checks are supplemental to the displayed analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: One-step exact-real-arithmetic result for explicit midpoint on a planar anisotropic linear oscillator with a positive-definite quadratic energy. Uniform phase refers to energy-circle angle. Does not imply global failure or success for other solvers, root-selection strategies, or Runge--Kutta schemes.
title: Sharp phase-failure law for quasi-orthogonal midpoint energy projection
